name: Stephanie Offers to Restore the House in Exchange for Lifting the Curse
description: It's too dark to see much of anything. Stephanie stumbles over something left on the floor. A voice speaks: MRS. GANUSH I knew you'd come. Stephanie nearly jumps in fright. As her eyes adjust, she sees Mrs. Ganush sitting on a crate in the corner, her arthritic hands clutching a yellowed photograph. STEPHANIE Hi. I'm here because I think I can help you. I can get your house back for you. MRS. GANUSH It's so empty now. STEPHANIE I can arrange for all your furniture to be brought back. Would that be okay? Mrs. Ganush does not look up. STEPHANIE So... on behalf of the bank I just want to resolve this to your satisfaction. This whole thing got personal and there was really no reason for that. The bank made a mistake and I can fix it for you and in return I'd like you to—cancel or call off, whatever you... you know— that thing you did to me. Okay? No hard feelings. My mother was a proud woman. Dignity. That's what she had. Stephanie nods, waits a moment, then places a document gently on the floor next to Mrs. Ganush. STEPHANIE All you need to do is sign here... She offers her a pen. STEPHANIE ...and I'll take care of the rest. Mrs. Ganush's hard eyes lock onto Stephanie's. MRS. GANUSH No. STEPHANIE No? But... I'm saying I'll make things right. Just sign this and you can keep the house. Isn't that what you wanted? MRS. GANUSH It was what I wanted before you shamed me. Now I want to see you suffer. STEPHANIE Please! I've suffered enough! MRS. GANUSH Not yet! Mrs. Ganush suddenly erupts in a broken-toothed cackle. Stephanie shouts, You're insane! Just... just a crazy old woman! I don't even know why I came here! MRS. GANUSH You know why. Terrified, Stephanie runs from the place.

name: Stephanie and Mrs. Ganush's Plea
description: Stephanie sits at her desk when she notices a withered hand scratching the surface. The hand belongs to Mrs. Ganush, the elderly woman who sits across from her. Mrs. Ganush, dressed in a threadbare formal outfit from another era, asks for help. She hands Stephanie a bundle of crumpled papers. Stephanie reviews them and finds a delinquency notice and a court order for repossession. The bank is set to seize Mrs. Ganush’s home on Brandon Street—trucks are already there, packing her belongings. Mrs. Ganush explains she has been ill, showing a milky white eye, and has not been able to make payments. She pleads for more time. Stephanie says she doesn’t think the manager can extend further credit but offers to ask. She approaches Mr. Jacks, who denies the request, citing prior extensions and accumulated fees. Stephanie returns and informs Mrs. Ganush of the decision. She suggests other living options, but Mrs. Ganush refuses, insisting the house is her home. Desperate, Mrs. Ganush kneels, begging for mercy. Stephanie calls for help. Mrs. Ganush rises, bows her head, then suddenly glares at Stephanie with a hardened gaze. She lunges and tries to grab Stephanie’s charm bracelet. A security guard rushes over, intervenes, and escorts Mrs. Ganush from the bank. Stephanie watches as she is led to her car. The car drives away and disappears down the street.

name: Stephanie Helps Mexican Couple with Mortgage Application
description: Stephanie sat at her desk with a young Mexican couple as they discussed their mortgage application. The couple explained that their application had been delayed because the lender would not accept it without a solvency statement from the Mexican Treasury Department, which could take another four weeks. The woman worried they would lose the house by then. Stephanie reviewed the form and noted the man worked for Pemex. When he confirmed this, she asked if Pemex was a subsidiary of Union Oil. He said yes. Stephanie realized that, technically, he was employed by an American company. She told them she believed she could resolve the issue and would call them that afternoon. The couple smiled, shook her hand, and left the bank.

name: Ellen Negotiates Shoes for Kitten Rescue
description: Ellen sat across from Stephanie and asked if she could borrow her black dress shoes. Stephanie refused, explaining they were her only good pair and she needed them for dinner with Ray's parents the next day. Ellen persisted, pointing out that Stephanie had the only perfect pair of black dress shoes in Los Angeles and asking if the refusal was final. Stephanie confirmed it was. When Ellen noticed the kitten peeking out from Stephanie’s desk drawer, she offered to take the kitten home. Stephanie hesitated, then agreed—on the condition that Ellen stop asking for the shoes. But as Mr. Jacks, Stephanie’s boss, began sneezing and searching for the source of his allergy, Ellen linked the two favors: she would take the kitten only if Stephanie let her have the shoes. Mr. Jacks approached their desk, still sneezing, and overheard Ellen say, 'Just don't expect me to take care of it.' He turned toward them, suspicious. In the moment, Stephanie gave in and told Ellen she could take the shoes. Out of Mr. Jacks’s sight, Ellen picked up the kitten and placed it in her purse.

Mrs. Ganush sits up in the back seat, screaming in Hungarian. She lunges at Stephanie, slashing with her fingernails toward her eyes. Stephanie grabs the woman's wrists, stopping the attack. The old woman then clamps her hands around Stephanie's throat. Struggling for air, Stephanie reaches for the box of contracts on the seat, pulls out a handful of colored push pins, and drives them into Mrs. Ganush's arm. The grip loosens.
